# Permissions reference

Every permission an endpoint checks (E10.1), by module, with the built-in roles that carry it out of the box. The Administrator role holds every permission.

| Permission | Module | Default roles | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.providers.manage` | auth | — | Configure identity providers and test their connections |
| `auth.roles.read` | roles | Support | View roles and who holds them |
| `auth.roles.write` | roles | — | Manage roles and assignments |
| `license.manage` | license | — | Install and remove license keys |
| `license.read` | license | Supervisor, Support, Viewer | View the license, usage against limits and the tier comparison |
| `logging.manage` | logging | Supervisor, Support | See the server log level and elevate it for a while |
| `settings.read` | settings | Supervisor, Support, Viewer | View settings and their values |
| `settings.write` | settings | — | Change settings |
